plugin.name: Neutralize FactionID HUD
plugin.description: Disables the separate FactionID mod's own on-screen faction HUD (its script becomes a no-op) so it doesn't show its own indicator alongside this mod's. Only install this if you also have FactionID installed.

plugin.name: Skill System: Perception
plugin.description: Adds a "perception" skill to the Skill System (haru_skills) mod and links it to identification speed: the higher your perception level, the faster you identify targets, and successful identifications grant perception XP. Only install this if you also have the Skill System mod installed.

plugin.name: Wearable Devices Compatibility
plugin.description: Gates identification behind wearable scanner gear from the st-wearable-devices mod. Adds a Promin Antenna module, a 3-tier Promin Process module, and a 3-tier worn Identification Scanner. With the full kit assembled (bracer worn + Promin with antenna and a process module + a worn scanner), identification runs on a tier system: the process tier sets scan speed and gradually unlocks the data shown (faction, distance, relationship, rank, weapon); the scanner tier sets range and unlocks scope/ADS support, a magnification range boost, and no-night-penalty. Tune every tier value on the mod's "Wearable Devices" MCM page. Only install this if you also have st-wearable-devices installed. Uses placeholder item art/models.
